Ben has been very on point about the 4 year cycle, Q4 bottom potential, a pull back in the second half of a midterm year and was openly telling people to start accumulating BTC as early as July when we first hit $60k.

He says all the time he never shorts Bitcoin.

I understand how he acts in Twitter can rub people the wrong way, loves to dunk on people doesn’t like getting dunked on back. But factually this post just isn’t correct.  

The problem imo is Twitter vs YouTube. 

YouTube requires you to actually watch someone’s content and digest their opinions. Whereas Twitter you can just kinda pick and choose. 

There are much better people on this website to dunk on. 

Not trying to dick ride just saying the facts.

Lmfao 

When I believe in something I’m just insanely delusionally bullish until I see it through

I understand if the majority of accounts on here mention a meme at $30M and have a target way higher but the market cools off for a bit will just go silent and take the L

I think if you’re able to foster a community in these conditions, and the coin is able to grow eventually it has the potential to become part of the lore of the chain itself

So there’s a period of time where you seem insane

And maybe you are

But eventually by being insane for long enough one day you’re not

And then in hindsight it looks obvious and at that point the market does the work for you
